records.title: Revision in Airfare Refund Norms
details: a: The regulations on' Air Ticket Refund', Civil Aviation Requirement (CAR), Section 3, Series M, Part II, titled 'Refund of Airline Tickets to Passengers of Public Transport Undertakings', is currently under review by Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
